body.title: Re-exports: EXPORTS edges, export_names, and calls through barrels
body.summary: In src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts: Pass 1b resolves each pending EXPORTS row to the named exported entity of the file its specifier resolves to (or that file entity for '*'), writes the EXPORTS edge with today's empty value and the export_names entry (file u64, exported name) -> target id in one transaction; resolveCall widens a caller's candidates by looking up the call's raw name in export_names of each imported file, following '*' entries to their source files, transitively with a visited set, ignoring an entry whose target is not stored. Anchors: resolveCall is at src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:465 and matches candidates by raw name (:494); no EXPORTS edge is written today, and every edge the store writes has an empty value (`s.outEdge.put(encodeOutEdgeKey(fromU64, kindByte, toU64), Buffer.alloc(0))`, src/db/relations.ts:434). Depends on t6 (the pending EXPORTS rows) and t8 (the pass structure and modes it extends).
acceptanceChecks: ac3 fixture: calls through `export { f } from`, an aliased re-export (g() resolves to f), a barrel of a barrel and `export *` resolve; a re-export cycle terminates with the name 'no-candidate'
The stored EXPORTS edge value is empty and export_names holds (barrel, 'g') -> f
An export_names entry pointing at a deleted target is ignored
